title: Icon-only close button has no accessible name
fix: Add aria-label="Dismiss announcement" and hide the svg

title: Email field relies on a placeholder instead of a label
fix: Add a visible <label for>

title: "Compare plans" is a paragraph with onclick: not focusable, no role
fix: Use a real <button> or <a href="#compare">

title: Focus outline removed with no replacement
fix: Restore a visible :focus-visible indicator with 3:1 contrast

title: Logo and hero images have no alt attribute
fix: alt="Ledgerly" for the logo, alt="" for the decorative shot

title: Plan availability in the comparison table is shown by colour only
fix: Add Yes/No text or icons with names; do not rely on red/green

title: Positive tabindex on the FAQ link breaks tab order
fix: Remove tabindex or use 0

title: Heading levels skip from h1 to h4 (plan names)
fix: Use h2 for sections and h3 for plan names

title: Infinite scrolling ticker cannot be paused and ignores reduced motion
fix: Remove it, or add pause control and prefers-reduced-motion

title: Lede text #bbb on white is about 1.9:1
fix: Darken to at least 4.5:1, e.g. #595959

title: White text on yellow button is about 1.4:1
fix: Use dark text (#222) on the yellow

title: Input border #e6e6e6 fails 3:1 non-text contrast
fix: Use a border of at least 3:1 against the background

title: Comparison table has min-width 560px, so the page scrolls sideways at 390px
fix: Allow it to reflow or wrap it in an overflow-x container with a label

title: Footer links are about 14px tall with 6px gaps (below 24px target size)
fix: Give links 24px+ targets or spacing (WCAG 2.5.8)

title: Feature line is clipped with overflow:hidden and no wrapping
fix: Allow wrapping or add an ellipsis with an accessible full text

title: 140px sticky header eats the viewport on mobile and covers anchor targets
fix: Shrink it, and add scroll-margin-top on anchor targets

title: Plan cards have different padding and height; CTAs do not align
fix: Make cards equal-height flex columns with the CTA pinned to the bottom

title: Text set at 11-12px (list items, badge, fine print)
fix: Raise body and list text to 16px, fine print to 14px minimum

title: About paragraph runs the full width at line-height 1 (about 160 characters a line)
fix: Cap at about 65ch and use line-height 1.5

title: Five unrelated typefaces (Georgia, Arial, Impact, Courier New, Comic Sans)
fix: Pick one or two families and use roles

title: Vague button labels: "Click here" (three times) and "Submit"
fix: "Start free trial" on plan buttons; "Get pricing updates" on the form

title: Error message "Error 422" says nothing about what happened or what to do
fix: Say what is wrong and how to fix it

title: "You entered an invalid email address" blames the user and gives no fix
fix: "Enter an email like name@example.com"

title: Plan, package and tier used for the same thing
fix: Choose one term (plan) and use it everywhere

title: Destructive confirmation uses OK and Cancel instead of naming the action
fix: Label the buttons "Delete workspace" and "Keep workspace"

title: transition: all and a hover that animates width and height
fix: Transition only opacity/transform/box-shadow; avoid layout properties

title: Inner radii do not nest: 8px card, 20px badge and mixed 4px/6px button radii
fix: Use concentric radii and one button radius

title: Emoji used as feature icons
fix: Use a consistent icon set with accessible names

title: Purple-to-blue gradient hero (stock generated look)
fix: Choose a palette tied to the product, drop the gradient

title: Viewport meta disables pinch zoom (maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no)
fix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable (WCAG 1.4.4)

title: No <main> landmark and no skip link; page is all divs
fix: Wrap content in <main>, add a skip-to-content link
